name: Dual Cell Optimization for Isosurface Extraction
aliases: Using Dual Cells at Same-level Regions
definition: An optimization that replaces octants with dual cells in non-boundary (same-level) regions to reduce the number of primitives traversed, achieving a ~4x speedup in extraction time.
summary: Dual Cell Optimization accelerates isosurface extraction by replacing octants with dual cells in same-level regions, reducing primitives and achieving a 4x speedup while preserving geometry.
